title: 第十四章  陆小欣
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

第二天清晨，一道道阳光从天空之中洒落，迷雾在每日初晨的短时间内是不会聚拢的。

叶落爬起来，看了眼那个女子，发现她气息已然平稳，伤口也几乎已经恢复，

“好强大的恢复能力！”叶落赞叹，但看她还没有睡醒也就没有喊她。

“是你救了我吗？”还没等叶落走出几步，身后便传来一阵甜美的声音，

“哦，你醒了，昨天晚上只是举手之劳罢了，你现在感觉怎么样？”

“好多了，基本上已经恢复了，我叫陆小欣，你呢？”陆小欣看起来心情还不错，

“我叫叶落，你也是世纪大学的学生吗？你昨天怎么会受这么严重的伤？”叶落有些疑惑，陆小欣手上的斗铠戒指的品质甚至比自己的还要高，能在贯穿斗铠的情况下，已然造成如此巨大的伤口，该是多强大的异兽，但渊灵之域外围应该没有多少强大的异兽

“呃”，“我姑且也算是世纪大学大三的学生，至于这伤，并非是异兽带来的”

“还有两天就要出去了，我就先走了”说罢，陆小欣周围灵力一荡，直接飞了起来，

叶落瞳孔微睁，不依靠斗铠就会飞，看来这位学姐比自己想象的强大太多了，反正暂时的自己必然不是她的一合之敌。

“对了，小学弟，名字告诉我也就罢了，其他人可不要轻易告诉啊，哈哈哈哈”空气中忽得传来一阵笑声。

叶落神色一滞，发出一丝苦笑，“大意了。”

而那边飞在空中的陆小欣脸色飞过两团红晕，自己昨晚可算是被他看光了，“叶落么，回去后我倒要看看他到底如何”，

”还有上官落雪这个贱人，看我不弄死你！“陆小欣眼中闪过一丝阴沉，“居然敢阴我。”“斗铠-金阙！”一刹那，无数斗铠金属粒子从戒指处浮现构造在陆小欣身上，

“嗡！“临渊境九重的灵力威压逸出，周围的异兽皆是瑟瑟发抖，这一次，她也算是动了真怒。

叶落自己也又开始了自己的捕猎之路，毕竟在这也不仅仅只是为了锻炼自己，也为了获取修炼资源，尤其是像他这样对灵力要求极高的人，现在修为低还好，一旦修为稍高，空气中的灵力就无法满足自己了，到那时，就必须借助灵石了，而灵石自然能用妖兽血肉来换，毕竟妖兽血肉也是不可多得的血气宝贝。

很快……便已经看到了一只体态巨大的妖兽正自卧在那里，爪子下面还压着一只足足成人大小的飞禽，正准备大快朵颐。

毫无疑问，这只狮虎兽刚刚捕猎完成，准备饱餐一顿，

“滴！狮虎兽1.1W战力，有点压力了！”叶落有点兴奋。

看到那狮虎兽身下的妖兽尸体。

Page (1/3)

Early the next morning, streaks of sunshine fell from the sky, and the fog would not gather in a short period of time every morning.

Ye Luo got up and glanced at the woman, finding that her breathing had stabilized and her wounds had almost recovered.

"What a powerful recovery ability!" Ye Luo praised, but seeing that she hadn't woken up yet, he didn't call her.

"Did you save me?" Before Ye Luo could take a few steps, a sweet voice came from behind,

"Oh, you're awake. It was just a little effort last night. How do you feel now?"

"Much better, basically recovered. My name is Lu Xiaoxin, what about you?" Lu Xiaoxin seemed to be in a good mood,

"My name is Ye Luo, are you also a student of Century University? How did you get such a serious injury yesterday?" Ye Luo was a little confused. The quality of the battle armor ring on Lu Xiaoxin's hand was even higher than his own. It could cause such a huge wound while penetrating the battle armor. What a powerful beast it must be, but there shouldn't be many powerful beasts outside the Yuanling Domain.

"Uh", "I can be considered a junior student at Century University. As for this injury, it was not caused by a strange beast."

"I'm going out in two days, so I'll leave first." After saying that, Lu Xiaoxin's surroundings swayed with spiritual power, and she flew up.

Ye Luo's pupils opened slightly, and he could fly without relying on the battle armor. It seemed that this senior was much stronger than he thought. Anyway, he was definitely not her enemy for the time being.

"By the way, little brother, just tell me your name. Don't tell others so easily, hahahaha." A burst of laughter suddenly came from the air.

Ye Luo's expression froze and he smiled bitterly, "I was careless."

Lu Xiaoxin, who was flying in the air over there, had two blushes on her face. She was completely seen by him last night, "Ye Luo, I want to see how he is after I go back."

"And this bitch, Shangguan Luoxue, let's see if I don't kill you!" Lu Xiaoxin's eyes flashed with gloom, "How dare you trick me." "Doukai - Golden Que!" In an instant, countless metal particles of the Doukai emerged from the ring and formed on Lu Xiaoxin's body.

"Buzz!" The spiritual pressure of the ninth level of Linyuan Realm escaped, and the surrounding beasts were trembling. This time, she was truly angry.

Ye Luo himself started hunting again. After all, he was here not only to train himself, but also to obtain cultivation resources, especially for a person like him who has extremely high requirements for spiritual power. It's okay if his cultivation level is low now. Once his cultivation level is slightly higher, the spiritual power in the air will not be enough for him. At that time, he will have to rely on spirit stones, and spirit stones can naturally be exchanged for monster flesh and blood. After all, monster flesh and blood are also rare blood treasures.

Soon... I saw a huge monster lying there, with an adult-sized bird under its claws, ready to feast.

There is no doubt that this liger has just finished hunting and is ready for a feast.

"Hey! The liger has 1.1W combat power, which is a bit stressful!" Ye Luo was a little excited.

See the monster corpse under the liger.
